Before invents "witless" and mistranslates 兒 as "heir," but the proposal wrongly makes Emperor Wu take the princes' hands; after 惠帝來朝 the hand-taking continues Hui's greeting, and 惠帝乃止 confirms he stopped that greeting when Wu said 是汝兒也.
